## Live Vocabulary Database

This database pulls directly from Google Sheets in real-time. Use the search bars at the top of each column to filter your entries.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Load the required libraries
library(googlesheets4)
library(DT)

# 2. Tell R not to look for interactive Google login credentials
gs4_deauth()

# 3. Paste your public Google Sheet URL below
sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1UQ5yqoBFqsCI7dBAHGYnTNFD9OY_AHntwj4dAkTiqTg/edit?usp=sharing"

# 4. Read the data directly from the cloud
dictionary_data <- read_sheet(sheet_url)

# 5. Display the data in an interactive searchable table
datatable(dictionary_data, 
          filter = 'top',
          width = '100%',
          options = list(pageLength = 15, autoWidth = TRUE),
          rownames = FALSE)
```
